verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop page says users can 'experience Ubuntu with different choices of default desktop environment, applications and settings, backed by the full Ubuntu archive.' That matches the story of official variants with different DEs and default apps. The support rests on a single first-party marketing line. Missing for 10: names of the specific official variants and their desktop environments, detailed docs on choosing or installing a variant, independent or hands-on corroboration of current official variants.
